coverage_notes: Original is Strict OOXML. Read-only Word COM observed effective style defaults; temporary transitional copies cross-checked XML. No template prose is redistributed.
This is the explicit 2019 source, not a claim of the current 2024/2026 master file.
Body page settings do not reproduce title/author multi-section front matter. Existing author facts are not replaced.
East Asian fallback font values are not treated as an English conference requirement.
Roman heading numbering, small caps and native reference hanging indents require distinct source-specific checks.
Typography and main-text page attributes derive from the pinned Word source; semantic policies retain their source-defined scope.
This fixed source version is not a claim of current compliance with every venue using the publisher's name.
